shortDescription: Manage a Linode NodeBalancer. NOTE: UDP NodeBalancer may not currently be available to all users.

options.name: client_conn_throttle
options.description: Throttle connections per second. Set to 0 (zero) to disable throttling.

options.name: client_udp_sess_throttle
options.description: Throttle UDP sessions per second (0-20). Set to 0 (zero) to disable throttling.

options.name: configs
options.description: A list of configs to apply to the NodeBalancer.

options.name: firewall_id
options.description: The ID of the Firewall to assign this NodeBalancer to.

options.name: label
options.description: The unique label to give this NodeBalancer.

options.name: region
options.description: The ID of the Region to create this NodeBalancer in.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags to assign to this NodeBalancer.
